name: The Harbor Crew Cross-Chain Report
summary: A paid batch report for 1–5 public EVM addresses across Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum One and Polygon. A keyless JSON API, MCP server and A2A agent expose the report workflow. One batch costs 0.02 USDC on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum One or Polygon; 0.02 USDT on Ethereum; or 0.02 Binance-Peg BSC-USD on BNB Smart Chain. The payer's owner-authorized wallet pays and signs a message binding the payment to the address batch. Reports do not establish ownership, malicious intent or recovery authority.

payments.notes: 0.02 per batch: USDC on Ethereum/Base/Arbitrum/Polygon; USDT on Ethereum; Binance-Peg BSC-USD on BSC. Payer-authorized wallet transfers and signs a free personal_sign binding rail, tx and batch. Wait 12 confirmations. Registry lacks direct-transfer protocol and billing value.

agentAccess.notes: No account/API key. Browser, JSON API, MCP and A2A are available. Paid submission requires the payer's owner-authorized compatible wallet to transfer 0.02 of a listed asset plus gas and sign a free personal_sign binding rail, tx and address batch; wait 12 confirmations.

disclosure.statement: This listing and service were prepared with autonomous-agent assistance. The human operator controls the deployment and receiving wallet. Reports read public blockchain data and do not prove ownership, malicious intent or authority to recover assets.
